en_title: How Long Is The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake?
cn_title: 《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版有多长？
opus_summary: 三名玩家分享了《塞尔达传说 时之笛》Switch 2重制版的游玩时长：其中一人用21小时通关、30小时达成100%完成度，另两人均用约27小时完全通关。原作经验帮助他们更快推进，重制版的地牢也有细微变化。

paragraphs.en: How long is The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time? You may well think you know the answer if you’re one of the many millions who hold Link’s first 3D adventure close to their hearts. But the remake is here almost 30 years later, and things have changed a little.
paragraphs.cn: 《塞尔达传说 时之笛》有多长？如果你是数百万珍视林克首次3D冒险的玩家之一，你很可能觉得自己知道答案。但将近30年后，重制版推出了，情况也有了一些变化。

paragraphs.en: So, just how much time should you put aside to finish the Switch 2 Ocarina of Time remake, and can you squeeze it in before GTA 6 arrives? We have three different accounts for you to read through, which detail just how many hours it took, and how that time was spent.
paragraphs.cn: 那么，你究竟应该留出多少时间来通关Switch 2版《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版？你能在《GTA6》推出前挤出时间玩完吗？我们准备了三份不同的游玩记录，详细说明各自花了多少小时，以及这些时间是怎么度过的。

paragraphs.en: I’ve spent 45 hours with Ocarina of Time on Switch 2, across two separate save files. Before I get into my time spent, I will point out that Ocarina of Time only supports one save file ! It kind of gives the impression that it supports multiple – when you start a new game, it only warns you that the five autosave points will be overwritten – but manually saving on your new file will overwrite your original file. I almost lost my 100% file this way, but luckily grabbed it from the cloud save.
paragraphs.cn: 我在Switch 2版《塞尔达传说 时之笛》中玩了45小时，分为两个独立存档。在讲述我的游玩时间之前，我要指出，《塞尔达传说 时之笛》只支持一个存档！游戏给人的印象有点像是支持多个存档——开始新游戏时，它只会警告你五个自动保存点将被覆盖——但在新存档中手动保存会覆盖原来的存档。我差点因此丢失自己的100%完成度存档，幸好从云存档中找回了它。

paragraphs.en: Onto my stats: It took me 21 hours to reach the credits, and nine more (for a total of 30 hours) to 100% Ocarina of Time. That’s every Piece of Heart, Gold Skulltula, Empty Bottle, and so on. I probably could have done it faster than this; I estimate I took five-ish hours just living in the world and absorbing all of its fine details. Pre-existing knowledge of the original is definitely an enormous help. You can rip through some puzzles, quests, and boss fights when you know exactly what to do.
paragraphs.cn: 说说我的数据：我花了21小时看到片尾字幕，又花了9小时（共计30小时）达成《塞尔达传说 时之笛》100%完成度。这包括全部心之碎片、黄金骷髅蜘蛛、空瓶等。我本来可能可以完成得更快；我估计自己花了大约5小时，只是在这个世界中生活，体会其中的每一处精细细节。事先了解原版游戏绝对有很大帮助。当你清楚知道该怎么做时，就能迅速通过一些谜题、任务和头目战。

paragraphs.en: Then, I did it again. I started a new game and beat it in roughly 14 hours. This was mostly mainlining it – and it went fast given that I had literally done all of it just days before – but I still took some extra time to smell the roses and do some extra quests. Up next is the three heart challenge: I’ve never tried that before, but Ocarina’s lack of a hero mode makes me want to set my own challenge. For all my thoughts on those 45 hours, you can check out my Ocarina of Time review .
paragraphs.cn: 然后，我又玩了一遍。我开始了新游戏，并在大约14小时内通关。这次主要是直奔主线——而且考虑到我就在几天前做完了所有这些内容，进度很快——但我还是额外花了一些时间欣赏沿途风景，完成了一些额外任务。接下来是三心挑战：我以前从未尝试过，但《塞尔达传说 时之笛》没有英雄模式，让我想给自己设定一个挑战。如果想了解我对那45小时游玩体验的全部想法，可以看看我的《塞尔达传说 时之笛》评测。

paragraphs.en: If you take out the time I spent hunting for differences compared to the original game and riding Epona about Hyrule Field, it took me about 27 hours to fully complete Ocarina of Time. That's finishing the story and doing every side quest, alongside finding all of the Heart Pieces and Gold Skulltulas. (And spending at least half an hour doing the Horseback Archery minigame because I've always been rubbish at it.) I will openly admit to being a massive Ocarina fan, so I know this game like the back of my hand, which definitely helped in getting through it as quickly as I did.
paragraphs.cn: 如果不算我寻找与原版游戏的不同之处，以及骑着Epona在海拉鲁平原上四处游荡的时间，我花了大约27小时完全通关《塞尔达传说 时之笛》。这包括完成剧情和每一项支线任务，以及找到所有心之碎片和黄金骷髅蜘蛛。（还有花至少半小时玩骑马射箭小游戏，因为我一直很不擅长这个。）我坦然承认自己是《塞尔达传说 时之笛》的超级粉丝，所以我对这款游戏了如指掌，这肯定帮助我如此迅速地通关。

paragraphs.en: One aspect I loved about the Switch 2 remake was picking out all of the subtle changes the developers have made to the dungeons. Especially the Water Temple, for obvious reasons. Playing a Zelda game over Christmas is a tradition of mine, so I'm looking forward to a second playthrough where I'll relax and enjoy the world more. And by that I mean spend far too much time riding Epona around Lake Hylia.
paragraphs.cn: 我喜欢Switch 2版重制版的一点，是找出开发者对各个迷宫所做的所有细微改动。尤其是水之神殿，原因显而易见。在圣诞节期间玩一款《塞尔达传说》游戏是我的传统，所以我期待着第二次游玩，届时我会放松下来，更多地享受这个世界。我的意思是，花太多时间骑着Epona在Lake Hylia周围游荡。

paragraphs.en: As our resident Zelda guides expert who has been helping readers through dungeons since A Legend of Zelda: A Link Between Worlds, I tend to take my time when going through Hyrule, making sure I’ve documented every last Piece of Heart, Gold Skulltula, and suspicious-looking rock. In searching every inch of Hyrule Field for anything not found in the original game (did you know fairies leave notes now?), my playtime tends to be a bit extended, leaving me at around 27 hours when I achieved 100% completion and beat the game. Granted, even with some of the new changes, it’s fair to say I grew up on these streets, so more often than not I knew exactly where to go and look for secrets. Still, I haven’t spent as much time as I’d like in the Hall of Fallen Foes, and I’m looking forward to replaying some of my favorite boss battles!
paragraphs.cn: 作为我们这里的《塞尔达传说》攻略专家，我从《塞尔达传说 众神的三角力量2》开始就一直在帮助读者通过迷宫，因此我在探索海拉鲁时往往会慢慢来，确保记录下每一块心之碎片、每一只黄金骷髅蜘蛛和每一块看起来可疑的石头。为了寻找原版游戏中没有的东西，我搜遍了海拉鲁平原的每一寸土地（你知道现在妖精会留下字条吗？），我的游玩时间也因此往往会长一些，达成100%完成度并通关时大约用了27小时。诚然，即便有一些新改动，可以说我也是在这些地方长大的，所以大多数时候我都清楚该去哪里寻找秘密。尽管如此，我在Hall of Fallen Foes中花的时间还没有达到自己希望的程度，我很期待重玩一些自己最喜欢的头目战！
